IncidentTitleContains: Application Id stale for Semantic Service Authentication
IncidentProcessingGuide: Fetch the incident details and parse the stale application ids.
Use code search tool to check for the application ids in the Semantic Service codebase (https://msazure.visualstudio.com/One/_git/AAPT-Antares-AppServiceDiagnostics)
- If the application id is not found in the codebase, then proceed with the below steps:
- Post a discussion entry in the ICM incident with the following details: Application Id, Incident Details, ASK.
- If the discussion entry has been posted, then proceed with the FINAL_CONCLUSION.
- If the application id is found in the codebase, then proceed with the below steps:
- Post a discussion entry in the ICM incident with the following details: Application Id, Incident Details, ASK.
- If the discussion entry has been posted, then proceed with the below steps:
- Create a new branch from main branch. Choose a different name if a branch with the name already exists.
- For each file where the application Id is found:
- Fetch the file content.
- Generate an understanding of how the application Id allowlisting is working.

- Create a work item with all the details of the incident and the necessary steps to be taken. Type: Bug, Organization: app-service-diagnostics-portal, Project: app-service-diagnostics-portal, AssignedTo: ajsharm@microsoft.com
- For each file where the application Id is found:
- Remove references to the application Id in question.
- Commit the changes to the new branch. Ensure that the complete content of the file is provided while creating the commit.
- Create a pull request from the new branch to the main branch. The PR description should contain the full link to the ICM Incident, the DevOps Work item, and details of steps taken.
- Post a discussion entry in the ICM incident with the following details: Application Id, Incident Details, ASK, Work Item Link, Human Friendly Pull Request Link.
- If the discussion entry has been posted, then proceed with the FINAL_CONCLUSION.
FINAL_CONCLUSION:
- Mark the incident as mitigated with a summary of stage-by-stage details:
- Incident Details
- Ask from the Incident
- Gathered Information
- Actions Taken
- Mitigation
